scope: Separate current exit pricing from durable strength; re-arm only outside-session refusals on a validated open window; guard name-only review citations
adjudication: CC FULL requests P1/P2 changes; GPT full1 ACK with three P3 follow-ups; the CC pricing-basis ruling governs. One fold on the reviewed parent after both verdicts were relayed.
red_production_source: Baseline 93f34f01 remained unchanged while the new test cases were run. The final RED reproduction uses a detached worktree at that exact parent with only the two named test modules overlaid.
covered_sequences: quote_stale -> take_profit at 100.50 -> stop_loss at 99.70, tolerances 0 and 100
risk_off/gap_risk_stop/corporate_action_flatten -> take_profit -> stop_loss or trailing_stop, tolerances 0 and 100
stop_loss -> trailing_stop under the shipped volatility preset, tolerances 0 and 100
weaker partial take_profit changes the pricing basis while the full-stop target and strength remain, tolerances 0 and 100
second basis change while cancellation is pending: one cancel, no second sell before acknowledgement, final 40-share fill leaves a 60-share replacement, tolerances 0 and 100
target strengthens during pending cancellation: re-read 100-share residual instead of stale staged 50, tolerances 0 and 100
no new exit after journal reopen retains the last pricing basis, tolerances 0 and 100
a close-boundary refusal blocks the closed window and strategy sells at the next open
next-session recovery sells after a close refusal, including a reopened legacy definitive-refusal record, without manual reconcile
custody_regression: tests/test_shared_runner_review_citations.py checks all four name-only review-reference collections and the helper citation, with synthetic forbidden-field and disguised-digest negative controls; no unpublished bytes or values are used in fixtures
boundaries: Captured native order factory and broker acknowledgements are synthetic; the real policy and durable Ledger execute
Risk/guard and volatility observations are explicitly controlled inputs
Session re-arming requires the validated controller window; no calendar is guessed by the Ledger
No live paper unit, host runtime lock, credential store, broker call or live guard file is used
output_sanitization: Checkout/runtime prefixes replaced by named placeholders; line-end whitespace normalized; assertion text and counts retained
followups: Adjacent rejection/accounting/mover diagnostics, old source comments and historical host-local capture portability remain separate and are listed in the PR body
